result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major missing-element issue and a minor accessibility improvement suggestion.

issues.description: The profile/avatar icon in the top-right corner appears as an empty white circle with only a small red dot, suggesting the user profile image failed to load or is missing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the profile image loads correctly or provide a default avatar icon as a fallback.

issues.description: The delivery location text 'Weizenbergi 20, Tallinn' uses a relatively thin font weight and small size, which may be harder to read for users with visual impairments.
issues.suggestion: Consider increasing the font weight or size slightly for better readability of critical location information.
